name: Ivan Horvat
bio:
Ivan's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at the University of Zagreb, a chance encounter with a local rally team ignited a passion that would define his career. He quickly became engrossed in the intricacies of vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. After graduating, Ivan honed his skills in various engineering roles, working his way up from junior mechanic to head of vehicle dynamics at a small racing outfit.

His meticulous approach to problem-solving, coupled with his ability to think outside the box, earned him a reputation as a valuable asset. Ivan's philosophy centers around a holistic understanding of the car, believing that true performance gains come from optimizing every aspect of the machine and the team's collaborative processes. He joined Caterham Motorsport to make a name for himself, seeking a team where he can lead on innovation and push his ambitious ideas forward.

Ivan's visionary spirit and technical competence are complemented by his strong management skills, fostering a positive and results-oriented environment within his team. He is regarded as a reliable leader who is always willing to mentor and support his team members. He is keen to prove his worth and help Caterham climb the motorsport ladder.

physical.description: Ivan is a man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing his own strong espresso every morning, regardless of where he is.
